title: A broadband grant's county rules
heading: Check k Against What the Plan Must and Can Fund Before You Solve
cases: a plan that brings every county to its target is allowed, and one that leaves a county short is refused
a plan within every crew limit is allowed, and one over a county's limit is refused
an upgraded hub with one backhaul link is allowed, and one with none is refused
a county already close to its target needs only the missing upgrades
an upgraded hub with two backhaul links is refused
a backhaul link for a hub that is not upgraded is refused
